title: Project Stutastic
tagline: Helps school management handle incoming parcels and lets students check their parcel information.
description: Built with Ali Imran. It has gone through four major versions since 2021, from a Material Design Lite prototype to the current v4 in development. The full changelog is on the [releases page](https://github.com/Jerit3787/stutastic/releases).

versions.name: v1
versions.note: Initial version: basic student data management, simple statistics, Firebase database (MDL).

versions.name: v2
versions.note: Enhanced Material Design UI, better data organisation and performance work.
